questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statement to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some teachers are philosophers.

Some philosophers are writers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some writers are teachers.

II. No writer is a teacher.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e4ef9de1da0e90ae36fce3c475d7b940c22ed86c077ec43b508120da6587d6b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some writers are teachers → False (It is possible but not definite.)

II. No writer is a teacher → False (It is possible but not definite.)

Both conclusions I and II forms complementary pair.

Hence, either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

8 × 2 + 5 - 16 ÷ 4 = 14
questions.solution:
According to BODMAS rule, the sequence of arithmetic operation will be Division, Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction.

8 × 2 ÷ 5 - 16 + 4 is not equal to 14

8 - 2 + 5 × 16 ÷ 4 is not equal to 14

8 ÷ 2 + 5 - 16 × 4 is not equal to 14

8 + 2 × 5 - 16 ÷ 4 is equal to 14

By interchanging x and +, we can make the equation correct.

Hence option 2 is correct.

questions.question: Nisha and Deepak are a married couple and have a daughter named Tanya. Currently, Deepak is 5 years older than Nisha and Nisha is thrice the age of Tanya. If Tanya is 10 years old, what was her father’s age at the time of his daughter’s birth?
questions.solution:
Let the present age of Tanya be X.

Given that X = 10

Nisha’s age = 3x

= 3 x 10 = 30

Deepak’s age = 30 + 5 = 35

Deepak‘s age at the time of Tanya’s birth = 35 - 10 = 25

Hence, 25 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Silent Valley National Park is located in the Indian state of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Kerala**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Silent Valley National Park is a beautiful representation of the last remaining rainforest of Kerala.
 
• Silent Valley was declared as National Park in 1984 and formally inaugurated in the year 1985.
 
• In 1914, Silent Valley forests were declared as Reserved Forest. Till 1921, Silent Valley was part of the South Malabar Forest Division with headquarters at Nilambur.
 
• In 1921, it came under the control of the Palakkad Forest Division and managed so until 1988.
 
• 41 mammals, 211 birds, 49 reptiles, 47 amphibians, 12 fishes, 164 butterflies, and 400 species of moths are found here.
 
• This park harbors a viable population of Lion-tailed macaques which also is the flagship species of the Park.
 
• It is at the heart of Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve and consists of areas of South Western Ghats rain forests and tropical wet evergreen jungle.
 
 
• River Kunthi passes through it.
 
 
 
• Flora: Humid wet Evergreen Rain Forests. The major plants of the park are Teak, Amla, Semal, Rosewood along bamboo.
 
• Fauna: Silent Valley Park is known for many highly endangered species such as lion-tailed macaque, tiger, gaur, leopard, wild boar, panther, Indian Civet, and Sambhar.

questions.question: Which of the following is a vestigial organ?
questions.solution:

• A vestigial organ is an organ in the body that has lost its use because of evolution

questions.question: What is the name given to the graph that shows all the combinations of two commodities that a consumer can afford at given market prices and within the particular income level in economic terms?
questions.solution:
• **The Budget Line** shows all the combinations of two commodities that a consumer can afford at given market prices and within the particular income level in economic terms
 
• In other words, the budget line will show how much quantity of two commodities can be bought by consumer if a certain budget is fixed
 
• The two constraints in this particular scenario are the fixed budget and the market price of the two goods
 
• If there are two goods X and Y, the budget equation can be expressed by **Pₓ X Qₓ + Py X Qy = M**
 
• Where Pₓ and Py are prices of X and Y, Qx and Qy are quantities of X and Y and M is the money income (budget) of consumer

In a circle with centre O, AB is the diameter and CD is a chord such that ABCD is a trapezium. If ∠BAC = 40°, then ∠CAD is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e5afc8d305d607027e416b0f8da008468f0101f8e7922753390ece9c021c09d.png] 

Given, ∠BAC = 40°

⇒ ∠ACB = 90° [angle in a semicircle is 90]

In ΔACB

⇒ ∠ACB + ∠CBA + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠CBA = 180° – 90° – 40° = 50°

• **Infatuated **- having a very strong but not usually lasting feeling of love or attraction towards someone(किसी के प्रति प्यार या आकर्षण की बहुत मजबूत लेकिन आमतौर पर स्थायी नहीं होने वाली भावना होना)
 
• **Incorrigible **- incapable of being corrected or amended(सुधार या संशोधन करने में असमर्थ)

In the context of the sentence, technology is described as something that people seem likely to get irrationally attached to. Hence, of all the given options, it can best be described as **addictive**.

Therefore, **option 1 is correct.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

People of the older generation ______ over the good old school days.
questions.solution:
From the context of the sentence, we see that the word in the blank needs to be combined with the preposition **over** to convey a meaning of longingly thinking about past experiences.

The words **remember** and **remind** can't be combined with **over** to convey this meaning.

The word **retribute** means **to pay back or give in return** and hence is contextually wrong.

The word **reminisces**, however, can be combined with the preposition **over **to mean **indulge in enjoyable recollections of past events.**

 
• Retribute - प्रतिकार करना
 
• Reminisce - याद करना
 
• Remind - याद दिलाना
 
• Remember - याद रखना

Hence, **option 2 is correct.**
